atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Add the same four diagnostics-only Taffy layout-bounds counters as experiment 18, with every fixed-size diagnostic contract updated in the initial implementation: the engine array, Scene transport, WGPU frame telemetry, browser publication, focused Test Suite assertions, and the existing gpui array oracle. This should reveal direct bounds-cache and parent-origin hit/miss behavior without altering layout or rendering semantics.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Run three fresh checkpoint headed Chromium/WebGPU Test Suite DataTable processes at DPR 1 and 2. Apply the complete diagnostics patch once, including the existing gpui oracle, then run formatting, gpui and gpui_wgpu tests, native diagnostics-off/on checks, single-thread WASM diagnostics check, warning-denied Clippy, and three candidate browser processes. Accept only if all established counters and output remain exact, the new accounting invariants hold, and median throughput/paced-p95 do not materially regress.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Produce exact warmed counts for total layout-bounds invocations, direct bounds hits, parent-origin hits, and parent-origin misses. The likely result is a high parent hit ratio that supports a later one-lookup fast path. No dependency, cache representation, renderer, shader, scene-order, or virtualization behavior changes.

playwright: Three fresh checkpoint Test Suite processes passed 6/6 DPR projects in headed Chromium/WebGPU with one worker.
No candidate browser process ran because a declared broad static gate failed before runtime measurement.
rayx: The complete candidate passed 456 gpui tests, including the expanded 20-entry Taffy diagnostics oracle.

The gpui_wgpu suite passed 51/52 tests but failed transformed_quad_uses_analytic_coverage because its pre-existing shader-source whitespace assertion did not find the literal multiline fragment. The telemetry patch did not touch shader code or that test.
All telemetry source and Test Suite changes were restored exactly to checkpoint 6ad344af843f238e0d6a13ffea4d9f820015af83.
counters: All checkpoint runs preserved 1123 Taffy nodes, 82 compute-layout calls, established renderer counters, final offset -351402.6875, and zero terminal error.
